segments.src: ### 1. Voter registration
segments.tr: ### 1. Registro de eleitor

segments.src: Most states set a registration deadline between about 30 days before Election Day and Election Day itself.
segments.tr: A maioria dos estados define um prazo de registro entre cerca de 30 dias antes do Dia da Eleição e o próprio Dia da Eleição.

segments.src: - **Earlier cutoffs:** Many states close registration roughly 15 to 30 days before the election. For a November 3 election, that can mean dates in mid-to-late October, and some may already be close.
segments.tr: - **Prazos anteriores:** Muitos estados encerram o registro aproximadamente 15 a 30 dias antes da eleição. Para uma eleição em 3 de novembro, isso pode significar datas em meados ou final de outubro, e alguns já podem estar próximos.

segments.src: - **Same-day registration:** A number of states let eligible voters register and vote at the same time, during early voting, on Election Day, or both. You usually need to bring proof of identity and residence.
segments.tr: - **Registro no mesmo dia:** Vários estados permitem que eleitores elegíveis se registrem e votem ao mesmo tempo, durante a votação antecipada, no Dia da Eleição ou em ambos. Você geralmente precisa levar comprovante de identidade e residência.

segments.src: - **Online vs. paper:** Online deadlines are sometimes later than mail deadlines. Mailed forms usually must be postmarked or received by the cutoff, depending on the state.
segments.tr: - **Online vs. papel:** Prazos online às vezes são posteriores aos prazos de correio. Formulários enviados por correio geralmente devem ser carimbados ou recebidos até o prazo limite, dependendo do estado.

segments.src: If you moved, changed your name or haven't voted in a while, check your registration status now.
segments.tr: Se você se mudou, mudou de nome ou não vota há algum tempo, verifique seu status de registro agora.

segments.src: Most state election websites let you do this in a minute or two.
segments.tr: A maioria dos sites eleitorais estaduais permite que você faça isso em um minuto ou dois.

segments.src: ### 2. Requesting a mail ballot
segments.tr: ### 2. Solicitação de uma cédula de voto por correio

segments.src: - **Automatic mailing:** In states that send ballots to all active registered voters, you don't need to request one. Your ballot is typically mailed in early-to-mid October, though some states start earlier. Military and overseas ballots go out much sooner under federal law.
segments.tr: - **Envio automático:** Em estados que enviam cédulas para todos os eleitores registrados ativos, você não precisa solicitar uma. Sua cédula é normalmente enviada por correio no início ou meados de outubro, embora alguns estados comecem mais cedo. Cédulas militares e do exterior são enviadas muito antes sob a lei federal.

segments.src: - **Request required:** In other states you must submit an application. Request deadlines commonly fall one to two weeks before Election Day, and some are earlier.
segments.tr: - **Solicitação necessária:** Em outros estados, você deve enviar um requerimento. Os prazos de solicitação caem comumente de uma a duas semanas antes do Dia da Eleição, e alguns são mais cedo.

segments.src: - **Standing requests:** Some states let you sign up once to receive a ballot for every election, or for several years.
segments.tr: - **Solicitações permanentes:** Alguns estados permitem que você se cadastre uma vez para receber uma cédula para cada eleição, ou por vários anos.

segments.src: Because mail takes time in both directions, requesting a ballot at the last minute is risky even if it's allowed.
segments.tr: Como o correio leva tempo em ambas as direções, solicitar uma cédula no último minuto é arriscado, mesmo que seja permitido.

segments.src: ### 3. Returning a mail ballot
segments.tr: ### 3. Devolução de uma cédula de voto por correio

segments.src: This is where the rules differ most:
segments.tr: É aqui que as regras mais diferem:

segments.src: - **Received-by deadlines:** Many states require your ballot to arrive by 7 or 8 p.m. local time on Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Prazos de recebimento:** Muitos estados exigem que sua cédula chegue até as 19h ou 20h horário local no Dia da Eleição.

segments.src: - **Postmark deadlines:** Some states count ballots postmarked by Election Day that arrive within a set window afterward, which can range from a few days to about two weeks.
segments.tr: - **Prazos de carimbo postal:** Alguns estados contam cédulas carimbadas pelo correio até o Dia da Eleição que chegam dentro de uma janela definida posteriormente, que pode variar de alguns dias a cerca de duas semanas.

segments.src: - **Ways to return:** Depending on the state, you may mail your ballot, drop it in an official drop box, or hand it in at an election office or voting location. Some states limit who can return a ballot for you, so check before handing yours to someone else.
segments.tr: - **Formas de devolução:** Dependendo do estado, você pode enviar sua cédula pelo correio, depositá-la em uma urna oficial ou entregá-la em um escritório eleitoral ou local de votação. Alguns estados limitam quem pode devolver uma cédula para você, portanto verifique antes de entregar a sua para outra pessoa.

segments.src: If you vote by mail, the safest choice is to send it back as early as you can.
segments.tr: Se você vota pelo correio, a escolha mais segura é enviá-la de volta o mais cedo que puder.

segments.src: Many election officials recommend mailing well before Election Day, and using a drop box or election office if the mail deadline is close.
segments.tr: Muitos oficiais eleitorais recomendam o envio por correio bem antes do Dia da Eleição, e o uso de uma urna de coleta ou escritório eleitoral se o prazo do correio estiver próximo.

segments.src: ### 4. In-person early voting
segments.tr: ### 4. Votação antecipada presencial

segments.src: - **Length:** Early voting runs from a few days to more than two weeks in states that offer it. Some begin in mid-October.
segments.tr: - **Duração:** A votação antecipada vai de alguns dias a mais de duas semanas nos estados que a oferecem. Alguns começam em meados de outubro.

segments.src: - **Hours and locations:** These often differ from Election Day. Counties may have fewer sites or shorter hours on some days, and some locations open only on certain dates.
segments.tr: - **Horários e locais:** Estes frequentemente diferem do Dia da Eleição. Os condados podem ter menos locais ou horários mais curtos em alguns dias, e alguns locais abrem apenas em datas específicas.

segments.src: - **Weekends:** Whether weekend voting is offered varies by state and county.
segments.tr: - **Fins de semana:** Se a votação de fim de semana é oferecida varia por estado e condado.

segments.src: Check your county's early-voting calendar and your assigned location.
segments.tr: Verifique o calendário de votação antecipada do seu condado e seu local designado.

segments.src: In some places you can vote at any early-voting site in the county, while in others you must go to a specific one.
segments.tr: Em alguns lugares você pode votar em qualquer local de votação antecipada no condado, enquanto em outros você deve ir a um específico.

segments.src: ### 5. Election Day voting
segments.tr: ### 5. Votação no Dia da Eleição

segments.src: Polls usually open in the morning and close in the evening, with hours set by state law.
segments.tr: As urnas geralmente abrem de manhã e fecham à noite, com horários definidos pela lei estadual.

segments.src: Anyone still in line when polls close is generally allowed to vote.
segments.tr: Qualquer pessoa ainda na fila quando as urnas fecham geralmente tem permissão para votar.

segments.src: Many states assign you a specific polling place, while others use countywide vote centers.
segments.tr: Muitos estados atribuem a você um local de votação específico, enquanto outros usam centros de voto em todo o condado.

segments.src: ## Voter ID rules
segments.tr: ## Regras de ID de eleitor

segments.src: ID requirements vary widely.
segments.tr: Os requisitos de identidade variam amplamente.

segments.src: Some states require photo ID, some accept non-photo documents, and some rely mainly on signature matching or other verification.
segments.tr: Alguns estados exigem documento de identidade com foto, alguns aceitam documentos sem foto, e alguns dependem principalmente da verificação de assinatura ou outra verificação.

segments.src: Mail ballots may have their own requirements, such as an ID number written on the return envelope.
segments.tr: Cédulas de voto por correio podem ter seus próprios requisitos, como um número de identidade escrito no envelope de devolução.

segments.src: Look up what your state requires before you vote, whether by mail or in person.
segments.tr: Procure o que seu estado exige antes de votar, seja por correio ou pessoalmente.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes that get ballots rejected
segments.tr: ## Erros comuns que fazem com que as cédulas sejam rejeitadas

segments.src: Most mail ballots are accepted, but small errors cause some to be set aside.
segments.tr: A maioria das cédulas de voto por correio é aceita, mas pequenos erros fazem com que algumas sejam separadas.

segments.src: The most common ones:
segments.tr: Os mais comuns:

segments.src: 1. **Missing signature.** Many states require you to sign the return envelope or a ballot affidavit.
segments.tr: 1. **Falta de assinatura.** Muitos estados exigem que você assine o envelope de devolução ou uma declaração juramentada da cédula.

segments.src: 2. **Signature mismatch.** Officials may compare your signature with the one on file. If you've changed how you sign, consider updating your registration.
segments.tr: 2. **Incompatibilidade de assinatura.** As autoridades podem comparar sua assinatura com a que está arquivada. Se você mudou a forma como assina, considere atualizar seu registro.

segments.src: 3. **Missing witness or ID information.** A few states require a witness signature or an ID number on the envelope.
segments.tr: 3. **Falta de testemunha ou informações de identidade.** Alguns estados exigem a assinatura de uma testemunha ou um número de identidade no envelope.

segments.src: 4. **Arriving late.** A ballot that misses your state's deadline may not be counted, even if you mailed it on time.
segments.tr: 4. **Chegar tarde.** Uma cédula que perde o prazo do seu estado pode não ser contada, mesmo que você a tenha enviado pelo correio a tempo.

segments.src: 5. **Skipping the security envelope.** Some states require the ballot to go in an inner "secrecy" envelope first. Leaving it out can invalidate the ballot.
segments.tr: 5. **Omitir o envelope de segurança.** Alguns estados exigem que a cédula vá em um envelope interno de "sigilo" primeiro. Deixá-lo de fora pode invalidar a cédula.

segments.src: 6. **Marking the ballot incorrectly.** Use the pen type the instructions call for, fill in the ovals completely, and don't mark more choices than allowed in a contest.
segments.tr: 6. **Marcar a cédula incorretamente.** Use o tipo de caneta que as instruções pedem, preencha os ovais completamente e não marque mais escolhas do que o permitido em uma disputa.

segments.src: 7. **Using the wrong envelope or returning someone else's ballot.** Each ballot is tied to one voter.
segments.tr: 7. **Usar o envelope errado ou devolver a cédula de outra pessoa.** Cada cédula está vinculada a um eleitor.

segments.src: 8. **Outdated address.** A ballot sent to an old address may never reach you.
segments.tr: 8. **Endereço desatualizado.** Uma cédula enviada para um endereço antigo pode nunca chegar até você.

segments.src: ### If there's a problem
segments.tr: ### Se houver um problema

segments.src: Many states have "ballot cure" processes.
segments.tr: Muitos estados têm processos de "correção de cédula".

segments.src: If officials find an issue such as a missing signature, they may contact you and give you a short window to fix it.
segments.tr: Se as autoridades encontrarem um problema, como uma assinatura faltando, elas podem entrar em contato com você e dar uma curta janela para corrigi-lo.

segments.src: Cure rules and deadlines differ by state.
segments.tr: As regras e prazos de correção diferem por estado.

segments.src: Many states also offer online ballot tracking, and some send email or text updates when your ballot is mailed, received and accepted.
segments.tr: Muitos estados também oferecem rastreamento de cédulas online, e alguns enviam atualizações por e-mail ou mensagem de texto quando sua cédula é enviada, recebida e aceita.

segments.src: If you can't confirm that your ballot arrived, contact your local election office.
segments.tr: Se você não puder confirmar que sua cédula chegou, entre em contato com seu escritório eleitoral local.

segments.src: ## A simple checklist for the next four weeks
segments.tr: ## Uma lista de verificação simples para as próximas quatro semanas

segments.src: - **Check your registration** on your state election website, and update your address or name if needed.
segments.tr: - **Verifique seu registro** no site eleitoral do seu estado e atualize seu endereço ou nome, se necessário.

segments.src: - **Find your deadlines** for registration, mail-ballot requests and returns.
segments.tr: - **Encontre seus prazos** para registro, solicitações de cédulas de voto por correio e devoluções.

segments.src: - **Decide how you'll vote:** by mail, early in person, or on Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Decida como você votará:** pelo correio, antecipadamente pessoalmente ou no Dia da Eleição.

segments.src: - **Read the instructions** that come with your ballot, including envelope and signature steps.
segments.tr: - **Leia as instruções** que vêm com sua cédula, incluindo as etapas de envelope e assinatura.

segments.src: - **Return your ballot early,** and track it if your state offers tracking.
segments.tr: - **Devolva sua cédula cedo,** e rastreie-a se o seu estado oferecer rastreamento.

segments.src: - **Confirm your polling place and hours** if you plan to vote in person.
segments.tr: - **Confirme seu local de votação e horários** se planeja votar pessoalmente.

segments.src: - **Bring any required ID.**
segments.tr: - **Traga qualquer documento de identidade necessário.**

segments.src: ## Where to get reliable information
segments.tr: ## Onde obter informações confiáveis

segments.src: Use official sources: your state election office or secretary of state website, your county or city election office, and Vote.gov, a federal site that links to each state's official information.
segments.tr: Use fontes oficiais: seu escritório eleitoral estadual ou site do secretário de estado, seu escritório eleitoral de condado ou cidade, e Vote.gov, um site federal que aponta para as informações oficiais de cada estado.

segments.src: Be cautious about unofficial websites, social media posts and messages that give dates or instructions, because they can be wrong or out of date.
segments.tr: Tenha cuidado com sites não oficiais, postagens em redes sociais e mensagens que fornecem datas ou instruções, porque elas podem estar erradas ou desatualizadas.

segments.src: If something looks unusual, verify it with your local election office.
segments.tr: Se algo parecer incomum, verifique com seu escritório eleitoral local.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: The deadlines that matter in the midterms depend on your state and sometimes your county.
segments.tr: Os prazos que importam nas eleições de meio de termo dependem do seu estado e, às vezes, do seu condado.

segments.src: A few minutes spent checking your registration, learning your state's mail and early-voting dates, and following the ballot instructions carefully can keep your vote from being rejected.
segments.tr: Alguns minutos gastos verificando seu registro, conhecendo as datas de correio e votação antecipada do seu estado e seguindo as instruções da cédula cuidadosamente podem evitar que seu voto seja rejeitado.

segments.src: With about a month to go, there's still time to plan.
segments.tr: Com cerca de um mês faltando, ainda há tempo para planejar.

in.title: Satu Bulan Menjelang Pemilu Sela: Perbedaan Batas Waktu Pemungutan Suara Awal dan Surat Suara Pos Berdasarkan Negara Bagian

segments.src: With Election Day on **Tuesday, November 3**, about a month away, voters in many states are about to receive mail ballots or start voting early.
segments.tr: Dengan Hari Pemilihan pada **Hari Selasa, 3 November**, yang tinggal sekitar sebulan lagi, para pemilih di banyak negara bagian akan segera menerima surat suara pos atau mulai melakukan pemungutan suara awal.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: A.S.

segments.src: has no single national rulebook.
segments.tr: tidak memiliki satu buku aturan nasional yang seragam.

segments.src: Each state sets its own registration cutoffs, mail-ballot rules and early-voting calendars, so the dates that apply to you depend on where you live.
segments.tr: Setiap negara bagian menetapkan batas waktu pendaftaran, aturan surat suara pos, dan kalender pemungutan suara awalnya sendiri, sehingga tanggal yang berlaku bagi Anda bergantung di mana Anda tinggal.

segments.src: This explainer covers the main differences between states, the deadlines to check, and the mistakes that most often get ballots rejected.
segments.tr: Penjelasan ini mencakup perbedaan utama antarnegara bagian, batas waktu yang perlu dicek, dan kesalahan yang paling sering membuat surat suara ditolak.

segments.src: It is general information, not legal advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat hukum.

segments.src: **Always confirm exact dates and rules with your state or local election office**, because deadlines and procedures can change.
segments.tr: **Selalu konfirmasikan tanggal dan aturan persisnya dengan kantor pemilu negara bagian atau lokal Anda**, karena batas waktu dan prosedur dapat berubah.

segments.src: ## Why the rules vary so much
segments.tr: ## Mengapa aturannya sangat bervariasi

segments.src: The Constitution leaves most election administration to the states.
segments.tr: Konstitusi menyerahkan sebagian besar administrasi pemilu kepada negara bagian.

segments.src: That produces a patchwork:
segments.tr: Hal itu menghasilkan sistem yang beragam:

segments.src: - Some states mail a ballot to every registered voter. Others require voters to request one.
segments.tr: - Beberapa negara bagian mengirimkan surat suara ke setiap pemilih terdaftar. Yang lain mengharuskan pemilih untuk memintanya.

segments.src: - Some offer weeks of in-person early voting. Others offer a few days, or none beyond limited in-person absentee voting.
segments.tr: - Beberapa menawarkan pemungutan suara awal tatap muka selama beberapa minggu. Yang lain menawarkan beberapa hari, atau tidak sama sekali selain pemungutan suara absensi tatap muka yang terbatas.

segments.src: - Some require an excuse to vote by mail. Most do not.
segments.tr: - Beberapa mewajibkan alasan untuk memilih lewat pos. Sebagian besar tidak.

segments.src: - Some accept mailed ballots that arrive after Election Day, as long as they were postmarked on time. Others require them to arrive by the close of polls.
segments.tr: - Beberapa menerima surat suara pos yang tiba setelah Hari Pemilihan, selama stempel posnya tepat waktu. Yang lain mewajibkannya tiba sebelum tempat pemungutan suara ditutup.

segments.src: ## Key deadlines to look up
segments.tr: ## Batas waktu penting untuk dicari

segments.src: ### 1. Voter registration
segments.tr: ### 1. Pendaftaran pemilih

segments.src: Most states set a registration deadline between about 30 days before Election Day and Election Day itself.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar negara bagian menetapkan batas waktu pendaftaran antara sekitar 30 hari sebelum Hari Pemilihan hingga Hari Pemilihan itu sendiri.

segments.src: - **Earlier cutoffs:** Many states close registration roughly 15 to 30 days before the election. For a November 3 election, that can mean dates in mid-to-late October, and some may already be close.
segments.tr: - **Batas waktu lebih awal:** Banyak negara bagian menutup pendaftaran sekitar 15 hingga 30 hari sebelum pemilu. Untuk pemilu 3 November, itu bisa berarti tanggal di pertengahan hingga akhir Oktober, dan beberapa mungkin sudah mendekati batas waktu.

segments.src: - **Same-day registration:** A number of states let eligible voters register and vote at the same time, during early voting, on Election Day, or both. You usually need to bring proof of identity and residence.
segments.tr: - **Pendaftaran hari yang sama:** Sejumlah negara bagian mengizinkan pemilih yang memenuhi syarat untuk mendaftar dan memilih secara bersamaan, selama pemungutan suara awal, pada Hari Pemilihan, atau keduanya. Anda biasanya perlu membawa bukti identitas dan tempat tinggal.

segments.src: - **Online vs. paper:** Online deadlines are sometimes later than mail deadlines. Mailed forms usually must be postmarked or received by the cutoff, depending on the state.
segments.tr: - **Online vs. kertas:** Batas waktu online terkadang lebih lambat daripada batas waktu pos. Formulir yang dikirim lewat pos biasanya harus memiliki stempel pos atau diterima sebelum batas waktu, tergantung negaranya.

segments.src: If you moved, changed your name or haven't voted in a while, check your registration status now.
segments.tr: Jika Anda pindah rumah, mengganti nama, atau sudah lama tidak memilih, periksa status pendaftaran Anda sekarang.

segments.src: Most state election websites let you do this in a minute or two.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar situs web pemilu negara bagian memungkinkan Anda melakukan ini dalam satu atau dua menit.

segments.src: ### 2. Requesting a mail ballot
segments.tr: ### 2. Meminta surat suara pos

segments.src: - **Automatic mailing:** In states that send ballots to all active registered voters, you don't need to request one. Your ballot is typically mailed in early-to-mid October, though some states start earlier. Military and overseas ballots go out much sooner under federal law.
segments.tr: - **Pengiriman otomatis:** Di negara bagian yang mengirimkan surat suara ke semua pemilih terdaftar yang aktif, Anda tidak perlu memintanya. Surat suara Anda biasanya dikirimkan pada awal hingga pertengahan Oktober, meskipun beberapa negara bagian memulainya lebih awal. Surat suara militer dan luar negeri dikirim jauh lebih awal berdasarkan undang-undang federal.

segments.src: - **Request required:** In other states you must submit an application. Request deadlines commonly fall one to two weeks before Election Day, and some are earlier.
segments.tr: - **Permintaan wajib:** Di negara bagian lain, Anda harus mengajukan permohonan. Batas waktu permintaan biasanya jatuh satu hingga dua minggu sebelum Hari Pemilihan, dan beberapa lebih awal.

segments.src: - **Standing requests:** Some states let you sign up once to receive a ballot for every election, or for several years.
segments.tr: - **Permintaan tetap:** Beberapa negara bagian memungkinkan Anda mendaftar sekali untuk menerima surat suara setiap pemilu, atau selama beberapa tahun.

segments.src: Because mail takes time in both directions, requesting a ballot at the last minute is risky even if it's allowed.
segments.tr: Karena pengiriman pos membutuhkan waktu di kedua arah, meminta surat suara pada menit-menit terakhir adalah hal yang berisiko meskipun diizinkan.

segments.src: ### 3. Returning a mail ballot
segments.tr: ### 3. Mengembalikan surat suara pos

segments.src: This is where the rules differ most:
segments.tr: Di sinilah aturan paling berbeda:

segments.src: - **Received-by deadlines:** Many states require your ballot to arrive by 7 or 8 p.m. local time on Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Batas waktu diterima:** Banyak negara bagian mengharuskan surat suara Anda tiba pada pukul 7 atau 8 malam waktu setempat pada Hari Pemilihan.

segments.src: - **Postmark deadlines:** Some states count ballots postmarked by Election Day that arrive within a set window afterward, which can range from a few days to about two weeks.
segments.tr: - **Batas waktu stempel pos:** Beberapa negara bagian menghitung surat suara yang diberi stempel pos selambat-lambatnya pada Hari Pemilihan yang tiba dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelahnya, yang dapat berkisar dari beberapa hari hingga sekitar dua minggu.

segments.src: - **Ways to return:** Depending on the state, you may mail your ballot, drop it in an official drop box, or hand it in at an election office or voting location. Some states limit who can return a ballot for you, so check before handing yours to someone else.
segments.tr: - **Cara mengembalikan:** Bergantung pada negara bagiannya, Anda dapat mengirimkan surat suara melalui pos, memasukkannya ke kotakdrop resmi, atau menyerahkannya di kantor pemilu atau lokasi pemungutan suara. Beberapa negara bagian membatasi siapa yang dapat mengembalikan surat suara untuk Anda, jadi periksalah sebelum menyerahkan milik Anda kepada orang lain.

segments.src: If you vote by mail, the safest choice is to send it back as early as you can.
segments.tr: Jika Anda memilih melalui pos, pilihan teraman adalah mengirimkannya kembali sesegera mungkin.

segments.src: Many election officials recommend mailing well before Election Day, and using a drop box or election office if the mail deadline is close.
segments.tr: Banyak pejabat pemilu menyarankan untuk mengirimkannya jauh-jauh hari sebelum Hari Pemilihan, dan menggunakan kotak drop atau kantor pemilu jika batas waktu pos sudah dekat.

segments.src: ### 4. In-person early voting
segments.tr: ### 4. Pemungutan suara awal tatap muka

segments.src: - **Length:** Early voting runs from a few days to more than two weeks in states that offer it. Some begin in mid-October.
segments.tr: - **Durasi:** Pemungutan suara awal berlangsung dari beberapa hari hingga lebih dari dua minggu di negara bagian yang menyediakannya. Beberapa dimulai pada pertengahan Oktober.

segments.src: - **Hours and locations:** These often differ from Election Day. Counties may have fewer sites or shorter hours on some days, and some locations open only on certain dates.
segments.tr: - **Jam operasional dan lokasi:** Hal ini sering kali berbeda dengan Hari Pemilihan. Kabupaten mungkin memiliki lebih sedikit situs atau jam operasional yang lebih singkat pada hari-hari tertentu, dan beberapa lokasi hanya buka pada tanggal tertentu.

segments.src: - **Weekends:** Whether weekend voting is offered varies by state and county.
segments.tr: - **Akhir pekan:** Ketersediaan pemungutan suara akhir pekan bervariasi menurut negara bagian dan kabupaten.

segments.src: Check your county's early-voting calendar and your assigned location.
segments.tr: Periksa kalender pemungutan suara awal kabupaten Anda dan lokasi yang ditugaskan kepada Anda.

segments.src: In some places you can vote at any early-voting site in the county, while in others you must go to a specific one.
segments.tr: Di beberapa tempat Anda dapat memilih di situs pemungutan suara awal mana pun di kabupaten tersebut, sementara di tempat lain Anda harus pergi ke tempat tertentu.

segments.src: ### 5. Election Day voting
segments.tr: ### 5. Pemungutan suara Hari Pemilihan

segments.src: Polls usually open in the morning and close in the evening, with hours set by state law.
segments.tr: Tempat pemungutan suara biasanya buka pada pagi hari dan tutup pada malam hari, dengan jam operasional yang ditentukan oleh undang-undang negara bagian.

segments.src: Anyone still in line when polls close is generally allowed to vote.
segments.tr: Siapa pun yang masih mengantre saat tempat pemungutan suara ditutup umumnya diizinkan untuk memilih.

segments.src: Many states assign you a specific polling place, while others use countywide vote centers.
segments.tr: Banyak negara bagian menetapkan tempat pemungutan suara tertentu untuk Anda, sementara yang lain menggunakan pusat pemungutan suara tingkat kabupaten.

segments.src: ## Voter ID rules
segments.tr: ## Aturan ID pemilih

segments.src: ID requirements vary widely.
segments.tr: Persyaratan ID sangat bervariasi.

segments.src: Some states require photo ID, some accept non-photo documents, and some rely mainly on signature matching or other verification.
segments.tr: Beberapa negara bagian mengharuskan ID berfoto, beberapa menerima dokumen non-foto, dan beberapa mengandalkan pencocokan tanda tangan atau verifikasi lainnya.

segments.src: Mail ballots may have their own requirements, such as an ID number written on the return envelope.
segments.tr: Surat suara pos mungkin memiliki persyaratannya sendiri, seperti nomor ID yang ditulis pada amplop pengembalian.

segments.src: Look up what your state requires before you vote, whether by mail or in person.
segments.tr: Cari tahu apa yang disyaratkan oleh negara bagian Anda sebelum Anda memilih, baik melalui pos maupun secara langsung.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes that get ballots rejected
segments.tr: ## Kesalahan umum yang membuat surat suara ditolak

segments.src: Most mail ballots are accepted, but small errors cause some to be set aside.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar surat suara pos diterima, tetapi kesalahan kecil menyebabkan beberapa di antaranya disingkirkan.

segments.src: The most common ones:
segments.tr: Yang paling umum:

segments.src: 1. **Missing signature.** Many states require you to sign the return envelope or a ballot affidavit.
segments.tr: 1. **Tanda tangan hilang.** Banyak negara bagian mengharuskan Anda menandatangani amplop pengembalian atau surat pernyataan suara.

segments.src: 2. **Signature mismatch.** Officials may compare your signature with the one on file. If you've changed how you sign, consider updating your registration.
segments.tr: 2. **Ketidakcocokan tanda tangan.** Pejabat dapat membandingkan tanda tangan Anda dengan yang ada di arsip. Jika Anda telah mengubah cara tanda tangan Anda, pertimbangkan untuk memperbarui pendaftaran Anda.

segments.src: 3. **Missing witness or ID information.** A few states require a witness signature or an ID number on the envelope.
segments.tr: 3. **Informasi saksi atau ID hilang.** Beberapa negara bagian mengharuskan tanda tangan saksi atau nomor ID pada amplop.

segments.src: 4. **Arriving late.** A ballot that misses your state's deadline may not be counted, even if you mailed it on time.
segments.tr: 4. **Tiba terlambat.** Surat suara yang melewati batas waktu negara bagian Anda mungkin tidak akan dihitung, meskipun Anda mengirimkannya tepat waktu.

segments.src: 5. **Skipping the security envelope.** Some states require the ballot to go in an inner "secrecy" envelope first. Leaving it out can invalidate the ballot.
segments.tr: 5. **Melewatkan amplop pengaman.** Beberapa negara bagian mengharuskan surat suara dimasukkan ke dalam amplop "kerahasiaan" bagian dalam terlebih dahulu. Mengabaikannya dapat membuat surat suara tidak sah.

segments.src: 6. **Marking the ballot incorrectly.** Use the pen type the instructions call for, fill in the ovals completely, and don't mark more choices than allowed in a contest.
segments.tr: 6. **Menandai surat suara dengan salah.** Gunakan jenis pena yang diminta dalam petunjuk, isi bulatan sepenuhnya, dan jangan menandai pilihan melebihi batas yang diizinkan dalam pemilihan.

segments.src: 7. **Using the wrong envelope or returning someone else's ballot.** Each ballot is tied to one voter.
segments.tr: 7. **Menggunakan amplop yang salah atau mengembalikan surat suara orang lain.** Setiap surat suara terikat pada satu pemilih.

segments.src: 8. **Outdated address.** A ballot sent to an old address may never reach you.
segments.tr: 8. **Alamat kedaluwarsa.** Surat suara yang dikirim ke alamat lama mungkin tidak akan pernah sampai kepada Anda.

segments.src: ### If there's a problem
segments.tr: ### Jika ada masalah

segments.src: Many states have "ballot cure" processes.
segments.tr: Banyak negara bagian memiliki proses "perbaikan surat suara".

segments.src: If officials find an issue such as a missing signature, they may contact you and give you a short window to fix it.
segments.tr: Jika pejabat menemukan masalah seperti tanda tangan yang hilang, mereka dapat menghubungi Anda dan memberi Anda waktu singkat untuk memperbaikinya.

segments.src: Cure rules and deadlines differ by state.
segments.tr: Aturan dan batas waktu perbaikan berbeda di setiap negara bagian.

segments.src: Many states also offer online ballot tracking, and some send email or text updates when your ballot is mailed, received and accepted.
segments.tr: Banyak negara bagian juga menawarkan pelacakan surat suara online, dan beberapa mengirimkan pembaruan email atau teks saat surat suara Anda dikirim, diterima, dan diterima.

segments.src: If you can't confirm that your ballot arrived, contact your local election office.
segments.tr: Jika Anda tidak dapat mengonfirmasi bahwa surat suara Anda telah tiba, hubungi kantor pemilu setempat Anda.

segments.src: ## A simple checklist for the next four weeks
segments.tr: ## Daftar periksa sederhana untuk empat minggu ke depan

segments.src: - **Check your registration** on your state election website, and update your address or name if needed.
segments.tr: - **Periksa pendaftaran Anda** di situs web pemilu negara bagian Anda, dan perbarui alamat atau nama Anda jika diperlukan.

segments.src: - **Find your deadlines** for registration, mail-ballot requests and returns.
segments.tr: - **Temukan batas waktu Anda** untuk pendaftaran, permintaan surat suara pos, dan pengembalian.

segments.src: - **Decide how you'll vote:** by mail, early in person, or on Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Tentukan bagaimana Anda akan memilih:** melalui pos, awal tatap muka, atau pada Hari Pemilihan.

segments.src: - **Read the instructions** that come with your ballot, including envelope and signature steps.
segments.tr: - **Baca petunjuk** yang disertakan dengan surat suara Anda, termasuk langkah-langkah amplop dan tanda tangan.

segments.src: - **Return your ballot early,** and track it if your state offers tracking.
segments.tr: - **Kembalikan surat suara Anda lebih awal,** dan lacak jika negara bagian Anda menyediakan pelacakan.

segments.src: - **Confirm your polling place and hours** if you plan to vote in person.
segments.tr: - **Konfirmasikan tempat pemungutan suara dan jam operasional Anda** jika Anda berencana untuk memilih secara langsung.

segments.src: - **Bring any required ID.**
segments.tr: - **Bawa ID apa pun yang diperlukan.**

segments.src: ## Where to get reliable information
segments.tr: ## Tempat mendapatkan informasi yang andal

segments.src: Use official sources: your state election office or secretary of state website, your county or city election office, and Vote.gov, a federal site that links to each state's official information.
segments.tr: Gunakan sumber resmi: kantor pemilu negara bagian atau situs web sekretaris negara bagian, kantor pemilu kabupaten atau kota Anda, dan Vote.gov, situs federal yang menautkan ke informasi resmi setiap negara bagian.

segments.src: Be cautious about unofficial websites, social media posts and messages that give dates or instructions, because they can be wrong or out of date.
segments.tr: Waspadalah terhadap situs web tidak resmi, postingan media sosial, dan pesan yang memberikan tanggal atau petunjuk, karena bisa jadi salah atau kedaluwarsa.

segments.src: If something looks unusual, verify it with your local election office.
segments.tr: Jika ada sesuatu yang tampak tidak biasa, verifikasikan dengan kantor pemilu setempat Anda.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The deadlines that matter in the midterms depend on your state and sometimes your county.
segments.tr: Batas waktu yang penting dalam pemilu sela bergantung pada negara bagian Anda dan terkadang kabupaten Anda.

segments.src: A few minutes spent checking your registration, learning your state's mail and early-voting dates, and following the ballot instructions carefully can keep your vote from being rejected.
segments.tr: Beberapa menit yang dihabiskan untuk memeriksa pendaftaran Anda, mempelajari tanggal pos dan pemungutan suara awal negara bagian Anda, dan mengikuti petunjuk surat suara secara cermat dapat mencegah suara Anda ditolak.

segments.src: With about a month to go, there's still time to plan.
segments.tr: Dengan sisa waktu sekitar sebulan, masih ada waktu untuk merencanakannya.

ja.title: 中間選挙まで1カ月：期日内投票と郵便投票の締切が州によってどのように異なるか

segments.src: With Election Day on **Tuesday, November 3**, about a month away, voters in many states are about to receive mail ballots or start voting early.
segments.tr: **11月3日（火）**の投票日まで約1カ月となり、多くの州の有権者がまもなく郵便投票用紙を受け取るか、期日前投票を開始します。

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 米国には

segments.src: has no single national rulebook.
segments.tr: 単一の全国共通のルールブックはありません。

segments.src: Each state sets its own registration cutoffs, mail-ballot rules and early-voting calendars, so the dates that apply to you depend on where you live.
segments.tr: 各州が独自の登録締切、郵便投票のルール、期日前投票のカレンダーを定めているため、あなたに適用される日付は居住地によって異なります。

segments.src: This explainer covers the main differences between states, the deadlines to check, and the mistakes that most often get ballots rejected.
segments.tr: この記事では、州間の主な違い、確認すべき締切、投票用紙が無効になりやすいミスについて解説します。

segments.src: It is general information, not legal advice.
segments.tr: これは一般的な情報であり、法的助言ではありません。

segments.src: **Always confirm exact dates and rules with your state or local election office**, because deadlines and procedures can change.
segments.tr: **正確な日付やルールは必ず州または地域の選挙管理事務所に確認してください**。締切や手順は変更される可能性があるためです。

segments.src: ## Why the rules vary so much
segments.tr: ## なぜルールがこれほど異なるのか

segments.src: The Constitution leaves most election administration to the states.
segments.tr: 憲法は選挙管理の大部分を各州に委ねています。

segments.src: That produces a patchwork:
segments.tr: そのため、パッチワークのような状態が生じています。

segments.src: - Some states mail a ballot to every registered voter. Others require voters to request one.
segments.tr: - 登録されているすべての有権者に投票用紙を郵送する州もあれば、有権者に請求を求める州もあります。

segments.src: - Some offer weeks of in-person early voting. Others offer a few days, or none beyond limited in-person absentee voting.
segments.tr: - 何週間もの対面による期日前投票を実施する州もあれば、数日間のみ、または限定的な不在者投票を除いて実施しない州もあります。

segments.src: - Some require an excuse to vote by mail. Most do not.
segments.tr: - 郵便投票に理由（正当な事由）を求める州もありますが、大半の州ではありません。

segments.src: - Some accept mailed ballots that arrive after Election Day, as long as they were postmarked on time. Others require them to arrive by the close of polls.
segments.tr: - 期限内に消印が押されていれば、投票日以降に到着した郵便投票用紙を受け付ける州もあります。投票終了時刻までに到着することを義務付けている州もあります。

segments.src: ## Key deadlines to look up
segments.tr: ## 確認すべき主要な締切

segments.src: ### 1. Voter registration
segments.tr: ### 1. 有権者登録

segments.src: Most states set a registration deadline between about 30 days before Election Day and Election Day itself.
segments.tr: ほとんどの州では、登録締切を投票日の約30日前から投票日当日の間に設定しています。

segments.src: - **Earlier cutoffs:** Many states close registration roughly 15 to 30 days before the election. For a November 3 election, that can mean dates in mid-to-late October, and some may already be close.
segments.tr: - **早めの締切：** 多くの州では、選挙のおよそ15〜30日前に登録を締め切ります。11月3日の選挙の場合、10月中旬から下旬の日付を意味することがあり、すでに期限が迫っている場合もあります。

segments.src: - **Same-day registration:** A number of states let eligible voters register and vote at the same time, during early voting, on Election Day, or both. You usually need to bring proof of identity and residence.
segments.tr: - **同日登録：** 期日前投票期間中、投票日当日、またはその両方に、資格を持つ有権者が登録と投票を同時に行える州が多数あります。通常、身分証明書と居住証明を持参する必要があります。

segments.src: - **Online vs. paper:** Online deadlines are sometimes later than mail deadlines. Mailed forms usually must be postmarked or received by the cutoff, depending on the state.
segments.tr: - **オンラインと郵送：** オンラインの締切は、郵送の締切よりも遅い場合があります。郵送の用紙は通常、州によって、締切日までに消印が押されているか、受領されている必要があります。

segments.src: If you moved, changed your name or haven't voted in a while, check your registration status now.
segments.tr: 引っ越しをした場合、改姓した場合、またはしばらく投票していない場合は、今すぐ登録状況を確認してください。

segments.src: Most state election websites let you do this in a minute or two.
segments.tr: ほとんどの州の選挙ウェブサイトでは、1〜2分でこれを確認できます。

segments.src: ### 2. Requesting a mail ballot
segments.tr: ### 2. 郵便投票用紙の請求

segments.src: - **Automatic mailing:** In states that send ballots to all active registered voters, you don't need to request one. Your ballot is typically mailed in early-to-mid October, though some states start earlier. Military and overseas ballots go out much sooner under federal law.
segments.tr: - **自動郵送：** アクティブな登録有権者全員に投票用紙を発送する州では、請求する必要はありません。投票用紙は通常10月上旬から中旬に郵送されますが、一部の州ではもっと早く開始されます。連邦法に基づき、軍人および海外在住者の投票用紙は 훨씬早めに発送されます。

segments.src: - **Request required:** In other states you must submit an application. Request deadlines commonly fall one to two weeks before Election Day, and some are earlier.
segments.tr: - **請求が必要な場合：** その他の州では、申請書を提出する必要があります。請求の締切は通常、投票日の1〜2週間前ですが、さらに早い場合もあります。

segments.src: - **Standing requests:** Some states let you sign up once to receive a ballot for every election, or for several years.
segments.tr: - **継続的な請求：** すべての選挙、または数年間、すべての選挙の投票用紙を受け取るために一度だけ登録できる州もあります。

segments.src: Because mail takes time in both directions, requesting a ballot at the last minute is risky even if it's allowed.
segments.tr: 郵便には往復で時間がかかるため、たとえ許可されていたとしても、直前に投票用紙を請求するのは危険です。

segments.src: ### 3. Returning a mail ballot
segments.tr: ### 3. 郵便投票用紙の返送

segments.src: This is where the rules differ most:
segments.tr: ここが最もルールが異なる部分です。

segments.src: - **Received-by deadlines:** Many states require your ballot to arrive by 7 or 8 p.m. local time on Election Day.
segments.tr: - **必着締切：** 多くの州では、投票日の現地時間の午後7時または8時までに投票用紙が到着している必要があります。

segments.src: - **Postmark deadlines:** Some states count ballots postmarked by Election Day that arrive within a set window afterward, which can range from a few days to about two weeks.
segments.tr: - **消印締切：** 投票日までに消印が押され、その後の一定期間（数日から約2週間）内に到着した投票用紙を集計する州もあります。

segments.src: - **Ways to return:** Depending on the state, you may mail your ballot, drop it in an official drop box, or hand it in at an election office or voting location. Some states limit who can return a ballot for you, so check before handing yours to someone else.
segments.tr: - **返送方法：** 州によって、投票用紙を郵送する、公式のドロップボックスに投函する、または選挙管理事務所や投票所に持参することができます。他人があなたに代わって投票用紙を返送できる人を制限している州もあるため、他人に渡す前に確認してください。

segments.src: If you vote by mail, the safest choice is to send it back as early as you can.
segments.tr: 郵便で投票する場合は、できるだけ早く送り返すのが最も安全な選択肢です。

segments.src: Many election officials recommend mailing well before Election Day, and using a drop box or election office if the mail deadline is close.
segments.tr: 多くの選挙管理者は、投票日のかなり前に郵送すること、および郵便の締切が迫っている場合はドロップボックスや選挙管理事務所を利用することを推奨しています。

segments.src: ### 4. In-person early voting
segments.tr: ### 4. 対面による期日前投票

segments.src: - **Length:** Early voting runs from a few days to more than two weeks in states that offer it. Some begin in mid-October.
segments.tr: - **期間：** 期日前投票を実施している州では、数日から2週間以上に及びます。10月中旬に開始する州もあります。

segments.src: - **Hours and locations:** These often differ from Election Day. Counties may have fewer sites or shorter hours on some days, and some locations open only on certain dates.
segments.tr: - **時間と場所：** これらは投票日とは異なることがよくあります。郡によっては、場所が少なかったり、一部の日で時間が短かったりする場合があり、特定の日付にのみオープンする場所もあります。

segments.src: - **Weekends:** Whether weekend voting is offered varies by state and county.
segments.tr: - **週末：** 週末投票が実施されるかどうかは、州や郡によって異なります。

segments.src: Check your county's early-voting calendar and your assigned location.
segments.tr: お住まいの郡の期日前投票のカレンダーと、割り当てられた場所を確認してください。

segments.src: In some places you can vote at any early-voting site in the county, while in others you must go to a specific one.
segments.tr: 場所によっては、郡内のどの期日前投票所でも投票できる場合もあれば、特定の投票所に行かなければならない場合もあります。

segments.src: ### 5. Election Day voting
segments.tr: ### 5. 投票日当日の投票

segments.src: Polls usually open in the morning and close in the evening, with hours set by state law.
segments.tr: 投票所は通常、朝に開き、夕方に閉まりますが、時間は州法によって定められています。

segments.src: Anyone still in line when polls close is generally allowed to vote.
segments.tr: 投票所が閉まる時にまだ列に並んでいる人は、一般的に投票が許可されます。

segments.src: Many states assign you a specific polling place, while others use countywide vote centers.
segments.tr: 特定の投票所が割り当てられる州もあれば、郡全体で投票センターを利用する州もあります。

segments.src: ## Voter ID rules
segments.tr: ## 有権者身分証明書（ID）のルール

segments.src: ID requirements vary widely.
segments.tr: IDの要件は大きく異なります。

segments.src: Some states require photo ID, some accept non-photo documents, and some rely mainly on signature matching or other verification.
segments.tr: 写真付きIDを求める州もあれば、写真付き以外の書類を受け付ける州、署名照合やその他の確認に主に頼る州もあります。

segments.src: Mail ballots may have their own requirements, such as an ID number written on the return envelope.
segments.tr: 郵便投票には、返信用封筒に記入するID番号など、独自の要件がある場合があります。

segments.src: Look up what your state requires before you vote, whether by mail or in person.
segments.tr: 郵便か対面かにかかわらず、投票する前に、あなたの州が何を求めているかを調べてください。

segments.src: ## Common mistakes that get ballots rejected
segments.tr: ## 投票用紙が無効になってしまうよくあるミス

segments.src: Most mail ballots are accepted, but small errors cause some to be set aside.
segments.tr: ほとんどの郵便投票用紙は受け付けられますが、ちょっとしたエラーで除外されてしまうものもあります。

segments.src: The most common ones:
segments.tr: 最も一般的なミスは以下の通りです。

segments.src: 1. **Missing signature.** Many states require you to sign the return envelope or a ballot affidavit.
segments.tr: 1. **署名の漏れ。** 多くの州では、返信用封筒または投票用紙の宣誓供述書に署名する必要があります。

segments.src: 2. **Signature mismatch.** Officials may compare your signature with the one on file. If you've changed how you sign, consider updating your registration.
segments.tr: 2. **署名の不一致。** 選挙管理官はあなたの署名を登録されている署名と照合する場合があります。署名の仕方を変更した場合は、登録の更新を検討してください。

segments.src: 3. **Missing witness or ID information.** A few states require a witness signature or an ID number on the envelope.
segments.tr: 3. **証人またはID情報の漏れ。** 一部の州では、封筒に証人の署名またはID番号が必要です。

segments.src: 4. **Arriving late.** A ballot that misses your state's deadline may not be counted, even if you mailed it on time.
segments.tr: 4. **到着の遅れ。** 州の締切に間に合わなかった投票用紙は、たとえ期限内に投函したとしても、集計されない場合があります。

segments.src: 5. **Skipping the security envelope.** Some states require the ballot to go in an inner "secrecy" envelope first. Leaving it out can invalidate the ballot.
segments.tr: 5. **セキュリティ封筒の入れ忘れ。** 一部の州では、まず内側の「秘密」封筒に投票用紙を入れる必要があります。入れ忘れると投票が無効になる可能性があります。

segments.src: 6. **Marking the ballot incorrectly.** Use the pen type the instructions call for, fill in the ovals completely, and don't mark more choices than allowed in a contest.

segments.src: 7. **Using the wrong envelope or returning someone else's ballot.** Each ballot is tied to one voter.

segments.src: 8. **Outdated address.** A ballot sent to an old address may never reach you.

de.title: Ein Monat bis zu den Zwischenwahlen: Wie sich Fristen für die Briefwahl und vorzeitige Stimmabgabe je nach Bundesstaat unterscheiden

segments.src: With Election Day on **Tuesday, November 3**, about a month away, voters in many states are about to receive mail ballots or start voting early.
segments.tr: Da der Wahltag am **Dienstag, dem 3. November**, noch etwa einen Monat entfernt ist, werden Wähler in vielen Bundesstaaten in Kürze ihre Briefwahlunterlagen erhalten oder mit der vorzeitigen Stimmabgabe beginnen.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Die USA

segments.src: has no single national rulebook.
segments.tr: haben kein einheitliches nationales Regelwerk.

segments.src: Each state sets its own registration cutoffs, mail-ballot rules and early-voting calendars, so the dates that apply to you depend on where you live.
segments.tr: Jeder Bundesstaat legt seine eigenen Fristen für die Registrierung, Regeln für die Briefwahl und Zeitpläne für die vorzeitige Stimmabgabe fest, daher hängen die für Sie geltenden Daten von Ihrem Wohnort ab.

segments.src: This explainer covers the main differences between states, the deadlines to check, and the mistakes that most often get ballots rejected.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden behandelt die wichtigsten Unterschiede zwischen den Bundesstaaten, die zu beachtenden Fristen und die Fehler, die am häufigsten zur Ablehnung von Stimmzetteln führen.

segments.src: It is general information, not legal advice.
segments.tr: Dies sind allgemeine Informationen, keine Rechtsberatung.

segments.src: **Always confirm exact dates and rules with your state or local election office**, because deadlines and procedures can change.
segments.tr: **Bestätigen Sie genaue Daten und Regeln immer bei Ihrem staatlichen oder lokalen Wahlamt**, da sich Fristen und Verfahren ändern können.

segments.src: ## Why the rules vary so much
segments.tr: ## Warum die Regeln so stark variieren

segments.src: The Constitution leaves most election administration to the states.
segments.tr: Die Verfassung überlässt die Verwaltung der Wahlen weitgehend den Bundesstaaten.

segments.src: That produces a patchwork:
segments.tr: Das führt zu einem Flickenteppich:

segments.src: - Some states mail a ballot to every registered voter. Others require voters to request one.
segments.tr: - Einige Bundesstaaten senden jedem registrierten Wähler einen Stimmzettel per Post. Andere verlangen, dass Wähler einen solchen anfordern.

segments.src: - Some offer weeks of in-person early voting. Others offer a few days, or none beyond limited in-person absentee voting.
segments.tr: - Einige bieten wochenlange vorzeitige Stimmabgabe persönlich an. Andere bieten nur wenige Tage oder gar keine, abgesehen von einer begrenzten persönlichen Abwesenheitswahl.

segments.src: - Some require an excuse to vote by mail. Most do not.
segments.tr: - Einige verlangen eine Begründung für die Briefwahl. Die meisten tun dies nicht.

segments.src: - Some accept mailed ballots that arrive after Election Day, as long as they were postmarked on time. Others require them to arrive by the close of polls.
segments.tr: - Einige akzeptieren Briefwahlunterlagen, die nach dem Wahltag eingehen, sofern sie rechtzeitig abgestempelt wurden. Andere verlangen, dass sie bis zum Schließen der Wahllokale eingehen.

segments.src: ## Key deadlines to look up
segments.tr: ## Wichtige Fristen, die Sie nachschlagen sollten

segments.src: ### 1. Voter registration
segments.tr: ### 1. Wählerregistrierung

segments.src: Most states set a registration deadline between about 30 days before Election Day and Election Day itself.
segments.tr: Die meisten Bundesstaaten setzen eine Registrierungsfrist zwischen etwa 30 Tagen vor dem Wahltag und dem Wahltag selbst fest.

segments.src: - **Earlier cutoffs:** Many states close registration roughly 15 to 30 days before the election. For a November 3 election, that can mean dates in mid-to-late October, and some may already be close.
segments.tr: - **Frühere Fristen:** Viele Bundesstaaten schließen die Registrierung etwa 15 bis 30 Tage vor der Wahl. Für eine Wahl am 3. November kann das Daten Mitte bis Ende Oktober bedeuten, und einige könnten bereits kurz bevorstehen.

segments.src: - **Same-day registration:** A number of states let eligible voters register and vote at the same time, during early voting, on Election Day, or both. You usually need to bring proof of identity and residence.
segments.tr: - **Registrierung am selben Tag:** Eine Reihe von Bundesstaaten erlaubt es wahlberechtigten Bürgern, sich gleichzeitig zu registrieren und abzustimmen, während der vorzeitigen Stimmabgabe, am Wahltag oder beides. Sie müssen in der Regel einen Identitäts- und Wohnsitznachweis mitbringen.

segments.src: - **Online vs. paper:** Online deadlines are sometimes later than mail deadlines. Mailed forms usually must be postmarked or received by the cutoff, depending on the state.
segments.tr: - **Online vs. Papier:** Online-Fristen sind manchmal später als Post-Fristen. Per Post versandte Formulare müssen je nach Bundesstaat in der Regel bis zur Frist abgestempelt oder eingegangen sein.

segments.src: If you moved, changed your name or haven't voted in a while, check your registration status now.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie umgezogen sind, Ihren Namen geändert haben oder schon länger nicht mehr gewählt haben, überprüfen Sie jetzt Ihren Registrierungsstatus.

segments.src: Most state election websites let you do this in a minute or two.
segments.tr: Die meisten Wahl-Websites der Bundesstaaten ermöglichen dies in ein oder zwei Minuten.

segments.src: ### 2. Requesting a mail ballot
segments.tr: ### 2. Anforderung eines Briefwahlzettels

segments.src: - **Automatic mailing:** In states that send ballots to all active registered voters, you don't need to request one. Your ballot is typically mailed in early-to-mid October, though some states start earlier. Military and overseas ballots go out much sooner under federal law.
segments.tr: - **Automatische Zusendung:** In Bundesstaaten, die Stimmzettel an alle aktiven registrierten Wähler senden, müssen Sie keinen anfordern. Ihr Stimmzettel wird normalerweise Anfang bis Mitte Oktober verschickt, obwohl einige Bundesstaaten früher beginnen. Militär- und Auslandsstimmzettel werden nach Bundesrecht viel früher versandt.

segments.src: - **Request required:** In other states you must submit an application. Request deadlines commonly fall one to two weeks before Election Day, and some are earlier.
segments.tr: - **Anforderung erforderlich:** In anderen Bundesstaaten müssen Sie einen Antrag stellen. Die Antragsfristen liegen üblicherweise ein bis zwei Wochen vor dem Wahltag, einige sind früher.

segments.src: - **Standing requests:** Some states let you sign up once to receive a ballot for every election, or for several years.
segments.tr: - **Daueranträge:** Einige Bundesstaaten erlauben es Ihnen, sich einmalig anzumelden, um für jede Wahl oder für mehrere Jahre einen Stimmzettel zu erhalten.

segments.src: Because mail takes time in both directions, requesting a ballot at the last minute is risky even if it's allowed.
segments.tr: Da die Post in beide Richtungen Zeit benötigt, ist es riskant, einen Stimmzettel in letzter Minute anzufordern, selbst wenn dies erlaubt ist.

segments.src: ### 3. Returning a mail ballot
segments.tr: ### 3. Rücksendung eines Briefwahlzettels

segments.src: This is where the rules differ most:
segments.tr: Hier unterscheiden sich die Regeln am stärksten:

segments.src: - **Received-by deadlines:** Many states require your ballot to arrive by 7 or 8 p.m. local time on Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Eingangsfristen:** Viele Bundesstaaten verlangen, dass Ihr Stimmzettel bis 19:00 oder 20:00 Uhr Ortszeit am Wahltag eingeht.

segments.src: - **Postmark deadlines:** Some states count ballots postmarked by Election Day that arrive within a set window afterward, which can range from a few days to about two weeks.
segments.tr: - **Poststempel-Fristen:** Einige Bundesstaaten zählen Stimmzettel, die bis zum Wahltag abgestempelt wurden und innerhalb eines festgelegten Zeitfensters danach eingehen, was von wenigen Tagen bis zu etwa zwei Wochen reichen kann.

segments.src: - **Ways to return:** Depending on the state, you may mail your ballot, drop it in an official drop box, or hand it in at an election office or voting location. Some states limit who can return a ballot for you, so check before handing yours to someone else.
segments.tr: - **Rückgabemöglichkeiten:** Je nach Bundesstaat können Sie Ihren Stimmzettel per Post versenden, in eine offizielle Wahlurne einwerfen oder bei einem Wahlamt oder einem Wahllokal abgeben. Einige Bundesstaaten schränken ein, wer einen Stimmzettel für Sie zurückgeben darf, prüfen Sie dies also, bevor Sie Ihren an jemand anderen weitergeben.

segments.src: If you vote by mail, the safest choice is to send it back as early as you can.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie per Briefwahl abstimmen, ist die sicherste Wahl, ihn so früh wie möglich zurückzusenden.

segments.src: Many election officials recommend mailing well before Election Day, and using a drop box or election office if the mail deadline is close.
segments.tr: Viele Wahlleiter empfehlen, den Stimmzettel weit vor dem Wahltag zu versenden und eine Wahlurne oder ein Wahlamt zu nutzen, wenn die Postfrist kurz bevorsteht.

segments.src: ### 4. In-person early voting
segments.tr: ### 4. Vorzeitige persönliche Stimmabgabe

segments.src: - **Length:** Early voting runs from a few days to more than two weeks in states that offer it. Some begin in mid-October.
segments.tr: - **Dauer:** Die vorzeitige Stimmabgabe dauert in den Bundesstaaten, die sie anbieten, von wenigen Tagen bis zu mehr als zwei Wochen. Einige beginnen Mitte Oktober.

segments.src: - **Hours and locations:** These often differ from Election Day. Counties may have fewer sites or shorter hours on some days, and some locations open only on certain dates.
segments.tr: - **Öffnungszeiten und Standorte:** Diese unterscheiden sich oft vom Wahltag. Landkreise haben möglicherweise an manchen Tagen weniger Standorte oder kürzere Öffnungszeiten, und einige Standorte öffnen nur an bestimmten Daten.

segments.src: - **Weekends:** Whether weekend voting is offered varies by state and county.
segments.tr: - **Wochenenden:** Ob eine Stimmabgabe am Wochenende angeboten wird, variiert je nach Bundesstaat und Landkreis.

segments.src: Check your county's early-voting calendar and your assigned location.
segments.tr: Überprüfen Sie den Kalender für die vorzeitige Stimmabgabe Ihres Landkreises und Ihren zugewiesenen Standort.

segments.src: In some places you can vote at any early-voting site in the county, while in others you must go to a specific one.
segments.tr: An manchen Orten können Sie an jedem Standort für vorzeitige Stimmabgabe im Landkreis wählen, während Sie an anderen zu einem bestimmten gehen müssen.

segments.src: ### 5. Election Day voting
segments.tr: ### 5. Stimmabgabe am Wahltag

segments.src: Polls usually open in the morning and close in the evening, with hours set by state law.
segments.tr: Die Wahllokale öffnen normalerweise morgens und schließen abends, wobei die Zeiten durch staatliches Gesetz festgelegt sind.

segments.src: Anyone still in line when polls close is generally allowed to vote.
segments.tr: Jeder, der bei Schließung der Wahllokale noch in der Schlange steht, darf im Allgemeinen noch wählen.

segments.src: Many states assign you a specific polling place, while others use countywide vote centers.
segments.tr: Viele Bundesstaaten weisen Ihnen ein bestimmtes Wahllokal zu, während andere landkreisweite Wahlzentren nutzen.

segments.src: ## Voter ID rules
segments.tr: ## Regeln für den Wählerausweis

segments.src: ID requirements vary widely.
segments.tr: Die Anforderungen an den Ausweis variieren stark.

segments.src: Some states require photo ID, some accept non-photo documents, and some rely mainly on signature matching or other verification.
segments.tr: Einige Bundesstaaten verlangen einen Lichtbildausweis, einige akzeptieren Dokumente ohne Foto, und einige verlassen sich hauptsächlich auf den Unterschriftenabgleich oder andere Verifizierungen.

segments.src: Mail ballots may have their own requirements, such as an ID number written on the return envelope.
segments.tr: Briefwahlunterlagen können ihre eigenen Anforderungen haben, wie z. B. eine auf den Rückumschlag geschriebene Ausweisnummer.

segments.src: Look up what your state requires before you vote, whether by mail or in person.
segments.tr: Informieren Sie sich vor der Stimmabgabe, was Ihr Bundesstaat verlangt, egal ob per Post oder persönlich.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes that get ballots rejected
segments.tr: ## Häufige Fehler, die zur Ablehnung von Stimmzetteln führen

segments.src: Most mail ballots are accepted, but small errors cause some to be set aside.
segments.tr: Die meisten Briefwahlunterlagen werden akzeptiert, aber kleine Fehler führen dazu, dass einige aussortiert werden.

segments.src: The most common ones:
segments.tr: Die häufigsten sind:

segments.src: 1. **Missing signature.** Many states require you to sign the return envelope or a ballot affidavit.
segments.tr: 1. **Fehlende Unterschrift.** Viele Bundesstaaten verlangen, dass Sie den Rückumschlag oder eine eidesstattliche Erklärung zum Stimmzettel unterschreiben.

segments.src: 2. **Signature mismatch.** Officials may compare your signature with the one on file. If you've changed how you sign, consider updating your registration.
segments.tr: 2. **Unterschriftenabweichung.** Beamte können Ihre Unterschrift mit der hinterlegten vergleichen. Wenn Sie Ihre Unterschrift geändert haben, sollten Sie Ihre Registrierung aktualisieren.

segments.src: 3. **Missing witness or ID information.** A few states require a witness signature or an ID number on the envelope.
segments.tr: 3. **Fehlende Zeugen- oder Ausweisinformationen.** Einige Bundesstaaten verlangen eine Zeugenunterschrift oder eine Ausweisnummer auf dem Umschlag.

segments.src: 4. **Arriving late.** A ballot that misses your state's deadline may not be counted, even if you mailed it on time.
segments.tr: 4. **Verspäteter Eingang.** Ein Stimmzettel, der die Frist Ihres Bundesstaates verpasst, wird möglicherweise nicht gezählt, selbst wenn Sie ihn rechtzeitig abgeschickt haben.

segments.src: 5. **Skipping the security envelope.** Some states require the ballot to go in an inner "secrecy" envelope first. Leaving it out can invalidate the ballot.
segments.tr: 5. **Weglassen des Sicherheitsumschlags.** Einige Bundesstaaten verlangen, dass der Stimmzettel zuerst in einen inneren „Geheimhaltungsumschlag“ gelegt wird. Das Weglassen kann den Stimmzettel ungültig machen.

segments.src: 6. **Marking the ballot incorrectly.** Use the pen type the instructions call for, fill in the ovals completely, and don't mark more choices than allowed in a contest.
segments.tr: 6. **Falsches Ausfüllen des Stimmzettels.** Verwenden Sie den Stifttyp, den die Anweisungen vorschreiben, füllen Sie die Ovale vollständig aus und markieren Sie nicht mehr Auswahlmöglichkeiten als bei einem Wettbewerb erlaubt.

segments.src: 7. **Using the wrong envelope or returning someone else's ballot.** Each ballot is tied to one voter.
segments.tr: 7. **Verwendung des falschen Umschlags oder Rückgabe des Stimmzettels einer anderen Person.** Jeder Stimmzettel ist an einen Wähler gebunden.

segments.src: 8. **Outdated address.** A ballot sent to an old address may never reach you.
segments.tr: 8. **Veraltete Adresse.** Ein Stimmzettel, der an eine alte Adresse gesendet wurde, erreicht Sie möglicherweise nie.

segments.src: ### If there's a problem
segments.tr: ### Wenn es ein Problem gibt

segments.src: Many states have "ballot cure" processes.
segments.tr: Viele Bundesstaaten haben Prozesse zur „Heilung“ von Stimmzetteln.

segments.src: If officials find an issue such as a missing signature, they may contact you and give you a short window to fix it.
segments.tr: Wenn Beamte ein Problem wie eine fehlende Unterschrift feststellen, können sie Sie kontaktieren und Ihnen ein kurzes Zeitfenster zur Korrektur geben.

segments.src: Cure rules and deadlines differ by state.
segments.tr: Die Regeln und Fristen für die Heilung unterscheiden sich je nach Bundesstaat.

segments.src: Many states also offer online ballot tracking, and some send email or text updates when your ballot is mailed, received and accepted.
segments.tr: Viele Bundesstaaten bieten auch eine Online-Stimmzettelverfolgung an, und einige senden E-Mail- oder Text-Updates, wenn Ihr Stimmzettel versandt, empfangen und akzeptiert wurde.

segments.src: If you can't confirm that your ballot arrived, contact your local election office.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie nicht bestätigen können, dass Ihr Stimmzettel angekommen ist, kontaktieren Sie Ihr lokales Wahlamt.

segments.src: A few minutes spent checking your registration, learning your state's mail and early-voting dates, and following the ballot instructions carefully can keep your vote from being rejected.
segments.tr: Ein paar Minuten, die Sie damit verbringen, Ihre Registrierung zu überprüfen, die Briefwahl- und vorzeitigen Wahltermine Ihres Bundesstaates zu lernen und die Anweisungen zum Stimmzettel sorgfältig zu befolgen, können verhindern, dass Ihre Stimme abgelehnt wird.
